$values.ValueExpression: from  a in db->MaintenancePeriods_calc where a->SortOrder_calc==MONTH($AssignedWorkDate_calc) select a->id
from a in db->Years where a->Year==YEAR($AssignedWorkDate_calc) select a->id

$values.ValueFilterExpression: from a in db->Staff_calc where a->WorkAssignee_calc==true select a->id

$values.InstanceFilterExpression: from a in db->PMTypes_calc where EQUALS(a->TechnicalSystem_calc, $Equipment_calc->TechnicalSystem_calc) select a->id
